framing.from: Nadia Al-Rubaie, director of non-revenue water and customer operations
framing.text: Water loss in Al-Rawdah is out of control. I need to know why before the board meets in two weeks.
Customers in Al-Hamra say their bills are wrong. Can you look into the estimated bills?

framing.from: Sultana Al-Kanaan, customer service operations manager
framing.text: Repeat complaints are too high. Find out what is going on.

framing.from: Mamdouh Al-Qarawi, metering and leak-repair engineer
framing.text: The acoustic-logger pilot in Al-Wurud found lots of leaks. Should we buy loggers for more districts?

framing.from: Nadia Al-Rubaie, director of non-revenue water and customer operations
framing.text: Do the smart meters work? Al-Nakheel's consumption went up after we installed them.

classify.text: How many leak repairs did each district have last quarter?
Which accounts are likely to get an estimated bill next month because the reader cannot reach the meter?
Did the first-contact target, introduced in every team at once, improve service?
Would a text message the day before the reader's visit raise the share of meters read?
Which mains are most likely to burst next summer?
What share of bills in Al-Hamra were estimated this year?
Did the move to smart meters in Al-Nakheel reduce water loss there, compared with similar districts?

constraint_change.text: Change of plan: the text-message budget is frozen until next year, and the board wants a decision on meter reading in ten business days. No new trial can run before then.
